question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated authority as CCP General Secretary, president, and Central Military Commission chairman, reinforced by earlier abolition of term limits and loyal personnel appointments across the Politburo and security apparatus, underpins trader expectations of continuity through the 21st Party Congress. With no scheduled leadership transition or institutional pressure before late 2027, and no verified elite challenges, health disclosures, or policy reversals surfacing in recent months, the 95.5% implied probability on "No" reflects broad consensus on structural stability. Potential shifts remain limited to low-probability events such as sudden incapacitation, abrupt internal realignment, or an unprecedented crisis forcing removal before year-end.
